hints.content:
The [[☃ definition 1]] is in the form $\dfrac{1}{p(x)}$ where $p(x)$ is a quadratic expression. This suggests that we should rewrite $p(x)$ by completing the square.

Specifically, we will rewrite $p(x)$ as a constant multiple of $(x+h)^2+k^2$. Then, we will be able to integrate using the following formula, which is based on the derivative of the inverse tangent function:

$\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{(x+\blueD h)^2+\maroonD k^2}\,dx=\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k} \text{arctan}\left(\dfrac{x+\blueD h}{\maroonD k}\right)+C$

[[☃ explanation 1]]

options.definition: The integrand is the expression within the integral expression. For example, the integrand of $\displaystyle\int (5x+1)\,dx$ is $5x+1$.

options.explanation:
This is the formula for the derivative of $\text{arctan}(x)$:

$\dfrac{d}{dx}\text{arctan}(x)=\dfrac{1}{x^2+1}$

Now let's use that formula and the chain rule to find the derivative of $\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k} \text{arctan}\left(\dfrac{x+\blueD h}{\maroonD k}\right)$:

$\begin{align}
&\phantom{=}\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k} \text{arctan}\left(\dfrac{x+\blueD h}{\maroonD k}\right)\right]
\\\\
&=\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\left(\dfrac{x+\blueD h}{\maroonD k}\right)^2+1}\cdot\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\dfrac{x+\blueD h}{\maroonD k}\right]
\\\\
&=\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k}\cdot\dfrac{\maroonD k^2}{(x+\blueD h)^2+\maroonD k^2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k}
\\\\
&=\dfrac{1}{(x+\blueD h)^2+\maroonD k^2}
\end{align}$

Now we can reverse the order to find the indefinite integral of $\dfrac{1}{(x+\blueD h)^2+\maroonD k^2}$:

$\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{(x+\blueD h)^2+\maroonD k^2}\,dx=\dfrac{1}{\maroonD k} \text{arctan}\left(\dfrac{x+\blueD h}{\maroonD k}\right)+C$

hints.content:
We start by rewriting $p(x)$ as a constant multiple of $(x+\blueD h)^2+\maroonD k^2$:

$\begin{align}
6x^2+36x+78&=6[x^2+6x+13]
\\\\
&=6[x^2+6x+9+4]
\\\\
&=6[(x+3)^2+4]
\\\\
&=6[(x+\blueD{3})^2+\maroonD{2}^2]
\end{align}$

Now we can find the integral:

$\begin{align}
&\phantom{=}\displaystyle\int \dfrac{1}{6x^2+36x+78}\,dx
\\\\
&=\displaystyle\int\dfrac{1}{6[(x+3)^2+2^2]}\,dx
\\\\
&=\dfrac16\displaystyle\int\dfrac{1}{(x+\blueD{3})^2+\maroonD{2}^2}\,dx
\\\\
&=\dfrac16\cdot\dfrac{1}{\maroonD{2}} \text{arctan}\left(\dfrac{x+\blueD{3}}{\maroonD{2}}\right)+C
\\\\
&=\dfrac{1}{12} \text{arctan}\left(\dfrac{x+3}{2}\right)+C
\end{align}$
